page.layout: One page of text in a single column. Full-width title heading at the top, with a decorated woodcut initial opening the text. One marginal note in the right margin, beside the first line. Catchword at the lower right, signature at the foot.

main_text.head: ORATIONIS, QUA FINEM IMPOSUI DISPUTATIONIBUS DE CONTROVERSIA EUCHARISTICA, Anno 1584. April. 15. delineatio.
main_text.p: ILLUSTRISSIME PRIN-Proœmiumceps & clementissime Domine: Magnifice Domine Rector; Generose D. Baro: amplissimi & prudentissimi D. Consiliarij; Et clarissimi omnium ordinum Doctores & Professores in hac Heydelbergensi Academia: heroica Nobilitas, ingeniorum & virtutum stemmatumque laude florentissima: Hospites lectissimi & ob eximia decora suspiciendi; Tuque literata iuuentus, Ecclesiae & Reipub. Christianae seminarium magis magisque efflorescens. Si per omnem meam vitam, ullo alio tempore, diu, multum & optime praemeditata Oratione mihi utendum fuit: hoc enim verò tempore eiusmodi Oratione mihi opus esse intelligo: quo videlicet, summa manus & veluti Catastrophe, σὺν θεῷ[?], imponenda est publicae huic de controversia Eucharistica Disputationi; tum quia Illustriss. Principis heroica clemen-tia, & erga nos bonitate, nobis utendum est, & habenda occupationum ciuilium quoque & maximè necessariarum ratio quaedam: tum, quia praeter huius & aliarum Academiarum usitatum morem, saepè nu-merò iam est disputatum: tum quia illi, quorum causa potissimum Disputatio instituta fuit, eadem

page.notes: The woodcut initial is read as I, joined to LLUSTRISSIME. The Greek phrase σὺν θεῷ is uncertain in its accents and breathing, so it is marked [?]. The printed "enimuerò" is read as enimverò. The margin note Proœmium is placed at the hyphen of PRIN-ceps, where it stands on the line. The page number 2 is printed at the top right corner. The faint text at the top and bottom of the scan is show-through and was left out. No running head is printed.
